none: PAS NLM-D5FCD4: Roman Nummus of Valens
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Valens, 364-378. Diameter: 16.95mm, Weight: 1.18gms. Die axis: 6. Obverse design: Bust diademed, draped and cuirassed facing Right. Obverse inscription: DNVALE[NS PF AVG] Reverse design: Emperor with standard (labarum) going Right dragging captive. Reverse inscription: [GLO]RIARO[MANORUM]. Cliff Reeves kindly commented on this coin. Finder’s ref: ‘Path Field’, TA 044…
